seoTitle: Connect and Link 2 Sheets in Smartsheet
metaDescription: Connect two Smartsheet sheets with live cell links so cross-functional data, like key milestones, updates in real time across both grids.
intro: When two teams track related work on separate sheets, keeping the numbers aligned by hand is a losing game. Smartsheet lets you connect sheets directly with live cell links, so a change on one grid flows through to the other automatically. This guide covers setting that connection up.

steps.heading: Know what a live link actually does
steps.body: Unlike copy-pasting, a cell link keeps two sheets in sync as the source data changes.

steps.heading: Start the link from your target cell
steps.body: Right-click a cell in your destination sheet and use the Link from Cell in Other Sheet feature.

steps.heading: Choose your source sheet
steps.body: Use the link wizard to navigate your workspace directory and select the sheet you want to connect to.

steps.heading: Link a whole data block
steps.body: Bulk-select multi-row ranges or entire status columns to pull rolled-up metrics in one action.

steps.heading: Confirm the connection
steps.body: Check the blue arrow indicators to confirm whether a cell is an incoming or outgoing live feed.

faq.question: How many sheets can I link together in Smartsheet?
faq.answer: There's no strict limit on the number of sheet-to-sheet connections, as long as each is set up through the Link from Cell in Other Sheet feature.

faq.question: What happens if I rename a linked sheet?
faq.answer: Renaming templates or restructuring columns can disrupt links, so it's worth preserving cell links carefully during those changes.

faq.question: Do both sheets update in real time?
faq.answer: Yes, once connected, changes in the source sheet flow through to the linked cells automatically.

faq.question: How do I tell which cells are linked?
faq.answer: Blue arrow indicators show whether a cell is receiving an inbound feed or sending an outbound one.
